item.tib: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs gsang ba thugs kyi brnag pa g.yung drung gi gsang rgyud drug gi don gyi 'grel ba yid bzhin gter mdzod
item.coloph: zhes gsang sngags a dkar theg pa'i spyi nor/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs gsang ba thugs kyi brnag pa g.yung drung gi gsang rgyud chen po drug tu grags pa'i don 'grel yid bzhin gter gyi mdzod chen zhes bya ba 'di ni/ snga mo dpe rgyud mjal ba nas bzung gus pa chen pos rtsis su 'dzin pa kho nas 'grel dang rnam bshad tshol ba'i 'dun pa yongs su skyes kyang / ji bzhin thob par ma gyur pa la phyis su snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa/ rang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son zhing / ris bral bstan pa rin po che'i bdag nyid/ mkhas shing grub pa yongs kyi khyu mchog rgyud sde 'di nyid kyi zab gter skal ldan kyi tshogs la rtsol bar mdzad pa'i gter chen khu tsha zla 'od 'bar gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i zlos gar du/ gter lung rdo rje'i tshig gis bsngags pa'i skyabs rje mchog sprul rin po che g.yung drung 'byung gnas rtsal lam 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal zhes yongs su grags pa'i snyan pas phyogs kyi 'khor lo khyab pa gang gi zhal snga nas rgyud sde rgya gar nas 'gyur ba sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gsang ba snying po de kho na nyid nges pa'i rgyud du gsol ba/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma mthong grol sogs nas rgyud sde brgyud pa ma chad par bzhugs pa'i sgo nas smin byed kyi dbang / grol byed kyi khrid/ rgyab rten gyi lung / rgyud bshad kyi bka' dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa bka' drin du mnos shing / bon lugs kyi sgyu 'phrul drwa ba 'di nyid kyang don gyi 'gag gcig par 'dug gshis lung 'grel man ngag 'di dag rnams la brten nas/ 'grel bshad nyung bsdus go bde ba zhig 'bri bar gyis dang phyis 'byung g.yung drung bstan pa'i zhabs gyur du'ang 'gro bar srid pas/ snyoms las dang le lo'i gzhan dbang du ma shor bar 'grub na legs pa'i bka' rtsal bslab ston gzings bstod dang bcas pas bslu med bden pa'i gsung gi byin gyis brlabs shing / bkas rjes su gnang ba la brten nas/ mdo gam lcang lung pa'i skye ba'i sgro 'dzin rmongs blun g.yung drung bstan 'dzin du 'bod pas rang nyid thos bsam yon tan gyi cha shin tu nyag 'phra bas 'grel bshad rtsom pa'i spobs pa bral yang / ris med mkhas dbang dam pa rnams kyi gsung gi rgya mtsho chen po la rjes su gzhol te/ rang lugs rnams kyi rnam bzhag zur ba phran bu'ang gsal bar byas nas/ rang 'dra'i dad gdung sel ba'i 'thung chur bskyil ba'i tshul du rang lo zhe gcig pa chu sprel sa ga zla ba'i tshes la grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid phyogs dus kun tu bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas dar zhing rgyas la yun ring por gnas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig pa'i smon pa dang bcas sa rba mu tsug smar ro//
